H2 is correctly ranked low: its sole HTTP/2-stream-starvation hop is ASSUMED (flagged by the automated check), it requires a 1h52m dormant period with no mechanism, and 254 gateway WARNs contain no GOAWAY/stream-reset fingerprint (F17). H4 is refuted by the pool pinning at the new limit while pre-onset demand was 11.98.
